scene.body_pose_source: automatic forearm box; full Sprout model optional

note: Default forearm_box mode derives the target box from camera detection. Sprout model, root pose and joints are unused. Opt in to representation=sprout_model to include the full body. Pregrasp/retreat are 10 cm above grasp; lift request is 15 cm, subject to IK and physical commissioning.

base_planning.note: Local search window, NOT a surveyed free-space claim. Verify bounds and surroundings before real base motion.
